title: remove(react): drop unused FormRenderer/FieldFactory duplicate form path (#2545 Phase 4)
body:
Phase 4 of #2545 (ObjectFormSchema ↔ spec `FormViewSchema` alignment).

## What & why

`packages/react/src/components/form/FormRenderer.tsx` (+ its captive `FieldFactory`) was an **exported-but-dead second form render path**: a repo-wide audit found **zero runtime consumers** — the only import anywhere was its own test file. It duplicated `@object-ui/plugin-form`'s `ObjectForm` (the path every app actually uses, via the component registry / `RecordFormPage`) but had drifted into a degraded variant — raw-HTML/Tailwind instead of the shared UI primitives, a hard-coded Submit button, and no support for `submitBehavior` / `aria` / `groups`. Keeping it around meant the form surface could silently drift in two places at once (the exact class of problem #2545 is about).

## Changes

- **Delete** `packages/react/src/components/form/` entirely (`FormRenderer`, `FieldFactory`, their test, README, index) and the now-empty `export * from './components/form'` in `packages/react/src/index.ts`.
- **Remove** the public exports `FormRenderer`, `FormRendererProps`, `FieldFactory`, `FieldFactoryProps`, `ExtendedFormField` from `@object-ui/react` — changeset added as **minor** (breaking, ships as minor per the pre-1.0 launch-window convention).
- **Docs:** delete `content/docs/core/form-renderer.mdx`, drop it from the core `meta.json` nav, repoint the `schema-renderer` and `enhanced-actions` cross-links (the latter to the live `/docs/components/form` page), and delete the stale `packages/types/examples/form-renderer-example.ts`.
- **Fix stale guidance** that listed `FormRenderer` as an `@object-ui/app-shell` export (it never was): `app-shell/README.md` and three skills guides; the plugin-development guide's registration example now shows the real `ObjectFormRenderer` symbol.

Historical CHANGELOG mentions are left untouched.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react... build` clean.
- `vitest run packages/react` → 23 files / 295 tests pass (the deleted `FormRenderer.test.tsx`'s 27 tests only ever exercised the removed code).
- Post-change grep confirms no `FormRenderer` / `FieldFactory` / `ExtendedFormField` references remain outside CHANGELOGs.

## Migration

Render forms through the `object-form` schema node (`@object-ui/plugin-form` `ObjectForm`, reachable from a `FormViewSchema` via `SchemaRenderer` / the spec bridge) — which is what all first-party apps already do.

Refs #2545.
